experienceGoal.playerProblem: 自動戦闘中に相手をどれだけ削れたか、直前にどちらが傷を負ったかが読めず、接敵を続けるか距離を取るか判断する手掛かりが不足している。
experienceGoal.targetState: 現在交戦中の自分と敵の生命、および直近の実接触の向き・損傷・防御を、序破急と移動操作を邪魔せず同時に読める。
successSignals: 交戦中、敵生命の減少と自分の生命を名前付きで読み分けられ、対象変更・交戦終了後に古い敵情報が残らない。
この相手との直近のnative contactを自分→相手／相手→自分と損傷・防御の違いで識別でき、構えや空振りだけでは命中表示が出ない。

rootCauses.summary: HUD updates the player's life bar and sequence, but does not project the active native opponent's remaining life alongside its identity.
rootCauses.observationEvidence: Immutable Before 03-play-04.png: the opponent has 18/38 HP after a native 20-damage contact, while only the NPC label and sequence are visible. 03-play-20.png: hero107/124 and enemy8/56 cannot be read as a paired comparison.
rootCauses.sourceEvidence: hud writes life-fill/life-text and skill-name; hunt-minimal-hud.css hides life-text. RaidSession.tick synchronizes the primary core enemy with fight.npc, and fight.core.state supplies authoritative maxhp.
rootCauses.prediction: A read-only active-opponent projection provides named, comparable HP meters without changing combat or adding a win-probability heuristic.
rootCauses.falsifier: Displayed opponent/HP differs from the current native fight, or remains after devour, retarget, overlay or finish.

rootCauses.summary: Transient hurt/action feeds do not expose both directions of native contact with guarded chip damage and a bounded combat-clock lifetime.
rootCauses.observationEvidence: Before 03-play-19 records source4→target3 damage17 at combat time8.465; 03-play-20.png at time12.169 has no readable attributed contact. Earlier native contacts include guarded damage4/4/6 and unguarded damage34.
rootCauses.sourceEvidence: event routes hurt through combatDamageLine, which takes amount/hp/maxhp but no opponent identity; outgoing contact is not routed there. Native core contacts already carry source,target,time,guard,damage and need no synthetic damage calculation.
rootCauses.prediction: Project only verified primary-fight contacts, identify their direction, distinguish guarded chip from no damage, and expire on the native combat clock.
rootCauses.falsifier: An attack/pose or stale/foreign/future contact is called a hit; incoming damage is labelled outgoing; guarded chip is described as zero damage; previous-fight history leaks.

workItems.summary: Show current primary opponent identity and paired native life meters only during unobstructed combat; indicate additional combatants without inventing their outcome.
workItems.evidence: Pure native-state projection, detached DOM leaf assertions and immutable After screenshots compared with Before03-play-04/20; verify hide/retarget lifecycle.
workItems.expectedPlayerFacingEffect: The player can compare damage suffered with damage dealt to this opponent when deciding to stay close or disengage.

workItems.summary: Display the latest real contact's direction, damage and guard distinction for four native combat seconds, without state mutation or wall-clock timers.
workItems.evidence: Regress native Before contact20 outgoing and contact17 incoming; test guarded chip, zero damage, future/expired/foreign contacts and no contact during windup; visually verify actual After contact ownership.
workItems.expectedPlayerFacingEffect: A hit, a defended hit and being hit no longer look like an unexplained pose or life-bar change.

observation.summary: Hosted native play on pinned immutable develop completed two actual combats and captures. Visual review covered title, entry, combat04/20, capture23 and lineage. The player lacks a readable paired attrition/contact view; the previous devour/return-guide repair is visibly working and is not reimplemented.

evidence.statement: Life and sequence updates omit the opponent's vitals; hurt-only feed lacks a paired directional contact receipt. Native Before04 has enemy18/38 after damage20; Before20 has hero107/124 and enemy8/56 after incoming17.

Each primary fight owns its own core and npc; core state provides fighter identities, maxhp and contact source/target/time/guard/damage. Ending combat clears fight rather than retaining a presentation history.

hypothesis.cause: Native fighter attrition and contact ownership exist but are not joined in a stable player-facing view.
hypothesis.prediction: Two related read-side changes make opponent progress and actual contact ownership readable, preserving native Tidebreak actions, input, capture and extraction authority.
hypothesis.falsifier: The UI invents outcomes, misattributes a contact, retains stale opponents, blocks input/sequence/guide, or remains visually unreadable on the immutable candidate.

candidates.reason: Small causal read-side implementation using existing authoritative data; no balance, runtime or persistence mutation.
A synthetic advantage score would invent a second outcome model and rebalance protected Tidebreak before proving a presentation problem.

implementation.summary: Add a scoped, pointer-transparent primary-combat readout to HuntFlowUi with native vitals/contact projection and two-work-item leaf regressions. No canonical workflow, quality gate, save, extraction, authored combat or input changes.

limitations: Primary-fight contact ownership is explicit; do not attribute secondary-core contacts to the primary opponent.
Native fresh-profile routes may differ in damage and learned traits; assess readability/authority, not balance.
One candidate evidence round and at most one repair/recheck; adopt before arming final merge-owning Astra validation.

workItemCoverage.evidence: Exact native HP projection plus DOM leaf/lifecycle tests and same-condition immutable screenshot review.
Actual Before contact samples plus guard/expiry/foreign-contact pure regressions and native After directional contact screenshots.
